The robots of J5 Smash Run (docs/maps/junkyard.md): Red starts inside the loader (rooms.json form small), so the loader's display stays hidden until she climbs out at the arena gate. ground false: the level supplies the floor. props are graybox stand-ins so the loader has something to smash; the Level Designer fills the Car Graveyard, the container canyon and the Foreman's Wall in VS-22. Kinds (crate_small, crate_large, container, car, lamp_post, building_*) come from combat/robot_yard.json. Positions are the map's metres in the level's coordinates.
